response.overview: Presented as a 1990s television broadcast from Blue Channel, this analog horror short introduces Thalasin—a pharmaceutical drug designed to grant users access to emotions beyond standard human biology. As the medical demonstration progresses from familiar emotional states to unsettling, surreal compounds like "Nage," "Dorcelessness," and "Trance-formation," the instructional video gradually devolves into a disturbing psychological nightmare.
response.title: BLUE_CHANNEL: THALASIN
